variants.name: UserSim Competitor Radar
variants.tagline: What launched in your space, and what real users said about it
variants.description: A standing watch on your market, built from real launches, not simulations. Each day and week: what launched in your space, where it finished, what real commenters asked for and complained about, and which products your own backers are moving toward. Groups only, never individuals.

variants.name: UserSim Competitor Radar
variants.tagline: Your competitors' launch day, read for you every morning
variants.description: Name your product and your rivals. Radar tracks every Product Hunt launch in your space, how it landed against its forecast, and the questions and complaints real users left on it, ranked by how many different people raised them. A weekly digest shows what your market asked for that nobody shipped.

variants.name: UserSim Competitor Radar
variants.tagline: See what users ask your competitors for, before you build it
variants.description: Real comments on real launches are the cheapest user research there is. Radar reads them for every launch in your space, groups them into what users asked for, complained about and praised, counts distinct people, and shows which voter groups backed each rival. Updated daily. No simulated answers.

panel.raw:
- [Tech Innovators] concern: How does the AI model handle unexpected virality or negative sentiment spikes? | question: Are there any plans for a native Mac app or a more integrated desktop experience?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: What's the refresh rate for the data, and is there any potential for API rate limits affecting accuracy? | question: Can we export the historical launch data for our own analysis, perhaps in CSV or JSON format?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: Is there a way to track specific keywords in comments or sentiment analysis for qualitative insights? | question: How does the AI predictor account for the 'hunter' effect or early community support?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: How robust is the AI predictor against manipulation attempts or bot activity on Product Hunt? | question: Will there be an API available for developers to integrate this data into their own dashboards?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: What kind of historical data is the AI predictor trained on, and how frequently is it updated? | question: Can we set up custom alerts for specific rank changes or comment thresholds?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: How does the tool ensure data accuracy, especially during peak traffic times on Product Hunt? | question: Are there any plans to integrate with other marketing analytics platforms for a more holistic view?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: What measures are in place to prevent data discrepancies if Product Hunt's API has intermittent issues? | question: Can we track multiple launches simultaneously and view them on a single dashboard?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: How does the AI predictor handle launches in niche categories with less historical data? | question: Is there a way to segment upvotes by user activity or influence score within the platform?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: What's the latency between an event on Product Hunt and it appearing in hunted.space? | question: Can we get insights into the geographic distribution of upvotes or comments?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: How transparent is the AI model's prediction logic? Can we see the factors influencing its odds? | question: Will there be a feature to track competitor launches automatically once they go live?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: What happens if Product Hunt changes its API or data structure? How quickly can hunted.space adapt? | question: Is there a free tier or trial available to test the full capabilities of the AI predictor?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: How does the AI predictor account for the 'Product of the Day' announcement's impact? | question: Can we integrate this data with Slack or other communication tools for real-time notifications?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: What's the pricing model for this tool, especially for teams managing multiple launches? | question: Are there any plans to offer a Chrome extension for quick access to stats while browsing Product Hunt?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: How does the AI model handle the initial hours of a launch when data is sparse? | question: Can we get a breakdown of upvotes by time zone to optimize our outreach efforts?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: Is there any risk of Product Hunt disliking or blocking tools that scrape their data? | question: Can we track the performance of specific comments or replies on our launch page?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: How does the AI predictor differentiate between genuine engagement and potential bot activity? | question: Will there be a feature to analyze the impact of different hunter choices on launch success?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: What's the accuracy rate of the AI predictor, and how is it validated? | question: Can we compare our launch performance against a benchmark of successful products in our category?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: How does the AI predictor account for the 'weekend effect' or holiday launches? | question: Are there any plans to offer a 'post-mortem' analysis feature to learn from past launches?
- [Launch Veterans] concern: How does the AI predictor handle the variability of Product Hunt's algorithm changes? | question: Can we track the engagement of specific users who upvoted our product?
- [Launch Veterans] concern: What's the data retention policy for historical launch data? | question: Will there be a feature to simulate different launch strategies and see predicted outcomes?
- [Launch Veterans] concern: How does the AI predictor account for external marketing efforts driving traffic to Product Hunt? | question: Can we get a breakdown of comments by sentiment (positive, neutral, negative)?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: What's the pricing structure like, and is there a free trial to see if it's worth the investment? | question: Does it integrate with any other marketing analytics tools I might already be using?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: How does the AI predictor handle products in very niche categories with limited historical data? | question: Can we get more granular data on the types of users who are upvoting our product?
- [Tech Innovators] concern: What's the underlying technology for the real-time data collection, and how scalable is it? | question: Will there be community features to share launch insights or best practices based on the data?
